messages:
Maria: Quick ops sync — tokens + throughput snapshot for Acme. TL;DR: WoW tokens +18%, QoQ +12%. Avg p95 latency 210ms (was 190ms last week). Error rate 0.9% with a Tue spike. Spend up ~22% WoW. Putting the key numbers below and asking for blockers / remediation ideas.

Rajiv: Yep — onboarding ramp explains much of the token jump. They pushed a new multi-turn integration last week and send long contexts (avg seq ~42k tokens). We also saw more small-streaming requests.

Lina: I investigated the Tue spike — one GPU worker hit OOM and we fell back to CPU rendering for ~1h which increased latency and errors. Alert M-453 triggered. Logs show repeated KV cache misses for sequences >60k.

Lina: Alert snippet:
```
ALERT M-453: worker_7 OOM -> fallback_to_cpu
first_seen: 2026-02-12T14:08:21Z
duration: ~58m
impact: p95 latency +80ms, error rate up to 2.6%
```

Rajiv: That aligns with payloads I saw. We've asked the client to trim context where possible, but we should also tune server-side. I pushed a batching tweak yesterday (lowered small-batch threshold) which should help with throughput for short chats.

Tom: Heads up — renewal discussion in 3 weeks. Sales wants a short mitigation plan to show we can cap spend and stabilize latency. Ask: can we offer a committed capacity proposal (15% off) if they sign a 6mo reserve? Also we want to schedule an enablement for their devs next Wed.

Maria: Action items I propose:
1) Lina confirm fix/patch ETA (aim <4h) and post verification metrics.
2) Rajiv drop representative payloads + top 5 prompt examples into #cs-docs for SRE to reproduce.
3) I'll draft a spend-optimization plan (batching + prefix cache + quantized model suggestion) and a one-pager for the renewal call.
4) Tom to coordinate enablement invite and desired topics.

Rajiv: I'll upload sample JSON to #cs-docs in ~30m. Note: they use streaming heavily with many short messages + occasional 50k sequences — probably safe to trim older context in most flows.

billing-bot: Acme projected monthly spend: $34,200 (+22% WoW). Current committed discounts: none.

Lina: Rolling fix deployed — capped seq handling and KV cache patch. Early signals: p95 down to 195ms, error rate ~0.2% over the last 45m. I'll keep an eye and post postmortem if anything persists.

Maria: Great, thanks. I'll update the renewal brief with the optimization levers and request a short cost/latency slide for the renewal deck. Will also book an enablement for Wed 10am PT. :thumbsup:

Tom: Thanks all — please leave any follow-ups in this thread. If the fix holds, I'll present the stabilizations and cost plan during the renewal prep.

Maria: One more note — client feedback: they'd like a short doc on "best practices for streaming + long-context apps". I'll start a draft and tag product for review.

Lina: Will add monitoring dashboards (token distribution by request length) and an alert to catch KV miss spikes earlier.

Rajiv: Cool. I'll also propose a small integration checklist for the enablement.

Maria: Closing for now — will post a summary update to the renewal thread after the enablement is scheduled.
